content.text: Fix the auth bug in login.py: the session cookie is not being set on refresh
Decision: switch to httpOnly secure cookies. We'll go with SameSite=Lax and drop the old parser.

Next: update the integration tests in tests/test_session.py.
Constraint: never store tokens in localStorage.
Reference: https://example.com/auth-cookies
```python
def set_cookie(resp, token):
    resp.set_cookie("session", token, httponly=True, secure=True, samesite="lax")
```
